name: Naomi Rodriguez
bio:
Naomi's fascination with motorsport began during her undergraduate studies, where she quickly realized the power of data-driven insights in optimizing performance. After graduating with a degree in Statistics and a minor in Mechanical Engineering, she landed an internship at a small racing team. She was responsible for analyzing telemetry data and creating performance reports, quickly showcasing her talent for identifying critical areas for improvement. Her ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations led to a full-time position and eventually her move to Trackhouse Racing.

At Trackhouse, Naomi is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis. She dives deep into every dataset, looking for patterns and correlations that others might miss. She's always pushing for new ways to visualize and interpret the data, ensuring that the team's engineers and drivers have the best possible information at their fingertips. Her goal is to make the team the smartest and most data-driven team on the grid, helping them secure wins and championships through the power of analytics.

What sets Naomi apart is her relentless pursuit of accuracy and her ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and concise manner. She is passionate about sharing her knowledge and empowering others to use data effectively. She is a dedicated professional who strives to be the best at what she does.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Naomi is of average height and has a lean athletic build.

quirks: Always has a cup of herbal tea on her desk, regardless of the weather.
Uses a whiteboard to visualize complex data patterns, even for routine tasks.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deeply focused, which can be distracting to others.
